failure_cause.instructions: Read `log_tail`, the last 200 lines of output from the CI job described by `repo`, `branch`, `runner` and `attempt_number` in the state. Classify why the job in `log_tail` failed.

criteria.transient_infrastructure: log_tail shows a network, DNS, registry, artifact-download, container-pull, or CI-service error (timeouts, connection resets, 5xx from an external service) unrelated to the job's own code or tests
criteria.resource_exhaustion: log_tail shows the job ran out of memory, disk space, or was killed/timed out by the runner for resource reasons, with no indication the code itself is at fault
criteria.flaky_test: log_tail shows a test failure whose own output indicates non-determinism (race condition, timing-sensitive assertion, intermittent/known-flaky test, retry-succeeded-before) rather than a consistent logic error
criteria.deterministic_code_failure: log_tail shows a compile error, type error, lint failure, or a test assertion failing on the actual behavior of the code being tested, with no sign of unrelated environmental interference
criteria.environment_configuration_issue: log_tail shows a missing/invalid environment variable, secret, credential, or misconfiguration that is specific to this pipeline's setup rather than a transient outage
criteria.unknown_insufficient_evidence: log_tail does not contain enough information to determine why the job failed
